title: Transcript to SRT/VTT subtitles
description: Splits a transcript you already have into SRT, WebVTT or plain-text cues at a chosen words-per-minute and cue length. Timing is estimated from word count and labelled as an estimate — this tool does not listen to audio.
x-privacyfold-engine: none (plain JavaScript in the browser tab)

input.description: Text to process. Sent to the tool only through the URL fragment / local input.
